evidenceBasis: yt-dlp flat channel enumeration (1,080 uploads, 100% net-new vs all three courses' existing external lanes) + oEmbed identity 229/229 + LLM title-to-spec adjudication under the tightened binding rule (title must name the spec's distinctive content; no high rows). Self-review standard applied as in P2B: medium kept when the video title names the spec's distinctive topic (partial clause coverage acceptable where the clause is the standard body of that topic); low kept only where the partial support is genuine and inline; rejected where the evidence field itself concedes the distinctive clause is not title-evidenced, where the video is a demo/teaching-ideas piece without the named content, or where the source level cannot carry the clause (e.g. IGCSE video for an A2 ratio clause). Board fit: channel is AQA-oriented; titles board-agnostic; the CIE/Edexcel fit of each row adjudicated individually and carried as boardMismatch:true.
